changes.comment: Breaking: a media value is one object. A `media()` field stores `{ "path": … }`, and `{ "path": …, "alt": … }` with the `alt` option; a plain path is refused with a message that names the shape. The value can hold free `properties`, and the format has a second shape for a file at a media provider (`provider`, `id`, `url`, `type`). The type `MediaWithAlt` is now `MediaFileValue`.
